fact_previews: Speech recognition systems require a preset collection of words or phrases that they can recognize.
Cloud-based recognition is an alternative to preset systems, but it is much slower and requires a stable Internet connection.
Most virtual assistants for both iOS and Android do not support natural conversation with the user.
A completely new blend of technologies using a neuro-linguistic approach and conditional random fields is needed to create complex cognitive patterns and learning algorithms.
Speech generation or synthesis that produces a naturally sounding voice requires the creation of sophisticated software or the purchase of expensive licenses.
